statement: Let A be a simple abelian surface and let A ,→ S′ be a closed embedding in a smooth connected projective complex variety. Suppose that im π1(A) −→ π1(S′ )  ≃ Z. There exist a smooth connected projective fourfold X with large fundamental group and a closed embedding A ,→ X with infinite cyclic image on fundamental groups, such that the universal cover of X is not Stein.
